proof_body:
by
  intro f S B hB hf
  have hs : S ⊆ Set.Icc (-B) B := fun x hx => abs_le.1 (hB x hx)
  have ht : TotallyBounded S := (isCompact_Icc.totallyBounded).subset hs
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.1 hf 1 one_pos
  obtain ⟨t, hts, htf, hc⟩ := Metric.finite_approx_of_totallyBounded ht δ hδ
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (htf.image (fun y => |f y|)).bddAbove
  refine ⟨M + 1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hc hx)
  have h1 := h x hx y (hts hy) hxy
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at h1
  have h2 : |f y| ≤ M := hM ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  have h3 : |f x| ≤ |f x - f y| + |f y| := by simpa using abs_add_le (f x - f y) (f y)
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (B : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ S, |x| ≤ B) → UniformContinuousOn f S → ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ S, |f x| ≤ K
